topic: No-hype gut health tier list for women in their 70s
text:
Gut health supplement tier lists are all over my feed this week.

Here's mine, in my 70s:
S tier: ask my doctor what mixes with what I already take
A tier: water, fibre, regular meals, sleep
B tier: one new thing at a time, so I know what's working

No hype. Just what I can stick to.
picture_tip: A handwritten S/A/B tier list on a notepad beside a glass of water and a bowl of oats on your kitchen table, window daylight. Square or 4:5.
video_tip: 8-10s: pen writes S, A, B tiers one by one; end on the glass of water. On-screen text: 'My gut health tier list in my 70s'.

topic: Skin barrier is back: simple winter routine + Trail Bay Friday
text:
Skin barrier talk is back all over my feed. Good.

Winter on the Sunshine Coast is hard on mature skin. I keep it simple:
Cleanser. Booster. Serum. Cream.
On dry skin, and I let each layer dry.

Try it on your own hand at Trail Bay, Sechelt this Friday, Nov 27, 11 to 4.
picture_tip: Your Balancing Gel Cleanser, Booster EX, Serum EX and Dermatology Cream in a row on the counter with rain on the window behind, soft daylight.
video_tip: 8-12s: set down each of the 4 products in order (text 'Dry skin first', then 'Let it dry'), end on the Trail Bay poster.
